title: Even Angels Eat Beans
writer: Enzo Barboni, Tulio Demicheli, Marie Claire Solleville
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Bud Spencer, Robert Middleton
plot: Striving for a higher standard of living, a former ice-cream man and a wrestler convince a well-known mobster to hire them. However, they both soon realize that criminal life is not what they were looking for.
